description: A client-side Fabric mod fetches, decodes and plays YouTube audio itself (playlist, play/pause, volume, seek) and keeps the playlist order, current track and pause state in sync per "party".

mods.name: YT Party
mods.description: YouTube and ARD Mediathek player (client) with party sync; optionally a picture-in-picture video and YouTube livestreams via ffmpeg, and other sites you allow via yt-dlp and ffmpeg. Same jar acts as the server-side host on a Fabric server.
